post.description: Any link to the product page works: it is canonicalized. The users share a product and its price history, each one tracks it for themselves. A product that has no price yet gets the read of its first price queued, which `jobId` names: follow it with `GET /jobs/{jobId}`. A user tracks a limited number of products and adds them at a limited rate.

get.description: A proxy is ready when it has an active browser session of the marketplace; `ready=false` lists the ones that still need it.

post.description: The workers are given the manual proxies before the found ones, whatever their check and exit country. A proxy that is listed already becomes manual. The address may carry `user:password@` for an HTTP(S) proxy: the credentials are kept apart, given to the workers only and never listed.

patch.description: A proxy that is off stays in the list but is not given to the workers, and a check does not turn it on. The server goes in the query: it has slashes.
